item.title: Pineville man on probation charged with assault with deadly weapon, strangulation
item.description: PINEVILLE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- A Pineville man was arrested Friday in connection to an assault investigation that occurred two days before. According to the Pineville Police Department, officers responded early on Wednesday to a violent incident in the parking lot of The Pines Apartments. Two victims sustained serious injuries. item.description: Friday afternoon brings another springlike surge of warmth with highs pushing into the low 80s.

item.title: One dead from shooting in north Charlotte: Medic
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- One person is dead from a shooting, and a homicide investigation is underway in north Charlotte Friday afternoon. Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police say they responded to an assault-with-a-deadly-weapon call shortly before 4 p.m. on Statesville Avenue at the intersection with Alma Court. item.title: Former Sycamore Brewing co-owner indicted on felony charges involving 13-year-old girl
item.description: A Stanly County grand jury has indicted the former co-owner of Sycamore Brewing on multiple felony charges connected to an alleged sexual assault involving a 13-year-old girl.

item.title: Two dead, more hurt after I-85 wrong-way crash shuts down the interstate in Concord
item.description: An early morning crash has taken two lives near the Concord-Padgett Regional Airport, according to the Mecklenburg EMS Agency (Medic).

item.title: Fort Mill neighbors want Silfab plant be removed following two leaks this week
item.description: The two chemical leaks seen at the facility over the last seven days were a 300-gallon release of water mixed with potassium hydroxide and a drip leak of hydrofluoric acid.

item.title: Silfab Solar leaders address chemical spills; operation to be shut down through weekend
item.description: Company officials said the first spill occurred Tuesday, followed by another incident on Thursday involving hydrofluoric acid.
